title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit Rulebook — Credit Correction When a Fare Is Adjusted
content:
# Credit correction when a fare is adjusted — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

**Rule.** When fare adjustments reduce a fare that earned Pass ride credit, the clawed-back credit is the whole credit earned on the trip, and the credit correction is that clawed-back credit. The credit correction is limited to the credit balance the member holds and is never below 0.00.

**Rounding.** The credit correction is rounded half up to the cent before it is limited to the balance.

## What is read

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| The trip | The trip whose fare charge carries the fare adjustment, in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) |
| Credit earned on the trip | The credit earn entry for that trip on the membership ledger |
| Credit balance | The Pass ride credit balance on the membership |

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical cases)

| Credit earned on the trip | Fare adjustment | Balance | Clawed-back credit | Credit correction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.80 | 6.00 off a 32.70 fare | 12.00 | 1.80 | 1.80 |
| 2.40 | 1.00 off a 41.00 fare | 0.50 | 2.40 | 0.50 (limited to the balance) |
| 3.10 | 4.00 off a 28.00 fare | 0.00 | 3.10 | 0.00 |

## Notes

- The correction is taken from the credit earned on the trip whose fare was reduced, and is booked against that trip's credit earn entry.
- The correction never exceeds the balance the member holds and never falls below 0.00.
